answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This endures because unearned rewards carry forward into the next pool, so even when a farm fails the economy recycles the loss rather than rewarding it. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a mirror as the anchor of the cost.
